summary: Research of w92 complete; notes.md in the stage directory has the seven parts. Accepted scenarios: 25 test ids run through a child pytest without the worker guard: 15 pass today, 10 red (undefined steps for awaiting-answer, Answers and kept branch Givens; the code still writes awaiting-ruling in supervise.py:156, supervise_merge.py:88,106 and workqueue.py:16 STATUSES lacks awaiting-answer; supervise_worker.py worktree() adds -b so a kept branch is refused; supervise_brief.py reads no Answers). Two open decisions for the planner: w91's open question on who renames the status in work run (w91 or w92), and whether the 10 deprecated accepted rows are retired (w92 has no Retires section). Tests-of had no coverage map, so test lists are by search. No tracked Python file is over 300 lines. Scratch files are git-ignored; git status is clean apart from the stage directory.
